prompt:
Use case: identity-preserve. Asset type: production 2D Heavy survivor animation for Grave Accord. Image 1 is the approved complete idle strip for this exact facing; it locks identity, camera and equipment grip. Image 2 is the original shipped single-facing seed. Both references show the required direction; do not invent an opposite-facing view. Preserve the same broad, stocky adult man with thick dark-brown hair and beard, a mustard-yellow ragged work coat/hood over charcoal sleeves and trousers, heavy brown boots/gloves, leather belt pouches and harness, and the brass cartridge bandolier crossing from physical LEFT shoulder to RIGHT waist. ONE dark iron six-barrel rotary gun has a brass ammunition belt. Physical RIGHT hand stays on its rear/top trigger grip; LEFT hand supports the forward cradle. Keep the gun rigid and both grips anatomically attached. No helmet, mask, second gun, weapon swap or extra belt. Use restrained dry black ink and matte opaque gouache, broad quiet color planes and selective practical contours. Avoid glossy gradients, excessive tiny scratches, decorative filigree or noise. Maintain two arms, two legs and one intact body/weapon in every pose.
Every pose faces NORTH, away from the viewer. We see back of hair/coat/cape, never the face. Retain the exact original back-facing equipment placement. The gun is partly hidden naturally in front of the body, with its visible portion matching the seed. Preserve physical RIGHT trigger and LEFT support grip; do not mirror straps or belt.
Draw EXACTLY 6 full-body poses as one coherent dash sheet, arranged in a clear 3-column by 2-row grid, read left-to-right then top-to-bottom. No additional figure. Action: One short grounded directional dodge: 1 full upright ready stance, 2 compress knees, 3 fast low weight-shift step, 4 compact transfer step, 5 plant/absorb the landing, 6 recover upright ready. Keep the same facing and camera in every pose. Keep BOTH hands securely on the SAME weapon with no new grip and only controlled cloth movement. No roll, somersault, huge leap, wing-like cape, clone, speed line, smoke or afterimage. Step AWAY from the viewer, screen UP, always showing the BACK of head/coat/cape. No face or side-profile reveal.
Every pose is one complete independent drawn body at ONE common character scale calibrated from upright pose 1. Crouched and resting poses retain their naturally lower height. Use roomy clear gutters between all cells and generous padding around the ENTIRE body/weapon/cape, with a consistent ground baseline in each row. Genuine RGBA transparency: alpha zero outside each figure and between limbs/props. No floor, shadow, backdrop, haze, vignette, glow, particles, checker pattern, text, labels, frame numbers or grid lines. Keep a coherent animation rather than unrelated character illustrations.
